scope: draft ScaleGrid lens header and blurb only; not a locale receipt

rows.title: Org lens
rows.blurb: Subsidiaries clustered by sector, sized by headcount, tinted by the share of roles inside with exposure score ≥ 50. Click to drill: company → department → team.

rows.title: Network lens
rows.blurb: Network zones and zone→zone reach (open / conditional / blocked, weighted). Red: an open-only path into a zone hosting a crown jewel. Drill into a subsidiary to see its reach edges.

rows.title: Access lens
rows.blurb: Resources ranked by exposure: cheapest outside path (org channels, network reach, or shadow-SaaS entry) × criticality × grant level (network-only access counts at 0.6).

rows.title: Impersonation lens
rows.blurb: Roles ranked by exposure score over mixed org + network paths: actor → channel → role → device → zone → reach → system. Weak controls count; red hops carry no verification or cross open reach.

rows.title: Shadow IT lens
rows.blurb: Unsanctioned SaaS sits outside the org boundary, sized by how many departments use it. Selecting one shows its entry path: internet → SaaS → sync into users’ zones → reach.

rows.title: Software risk lens
rows.blurb: Share of devices whose installed software makes compromise easier (ease ≥ 0.25: EOL, unsanctioned, or unpatched medium+ vulnerabilities). Ease lowers the role → device pivot cost. Drill to a team and click a device for its software, logs, and people.

rows.title: Log gaps lens
rows.blurb: Share of devices with a log-coverage gap: logs not forwarded (blind spot) or kept below the minimum retention. Devices without a logs block count as unknown, not as gaps. Gaps are flagged on paths; they never change reachability.

rows.title: 组织 视角
rows.blurb: 子公司按行业分组，节点大小表示员工人数，颜色深浅表示暴露评分≥50的角色占比。点击可逐层查看：公司→部门→团队。
